falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes below 4950 on any daily session in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breakdown below the August 2024 low equivalent would invalidate the 79% bottom pattern match, as the prior structure would be violated rather than forming a tradable low

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Blowoff score of 40 implies controlled volatility; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic selling rather than capitulation/bottom formation, breaking the pattern's volatility signature

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops more than 40 basis points from current level within any 3-day window
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A flight-to-safety bid of this magnitude signals systemic stress or recession panic, contradicting the 'bottom' signal which requires stabilization in risk-free rates to validate cyclical recovery

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
